name: google-drive
label: Google Drive
description: Google drive connector can be used to list, add, remove, download and upload files from google drive using playbook.

fields.title: Server URL
fields.name: server
fields.description: The service-based URL of the Google API server to which you will connect and perform the automated operations.

fields.title: Client ID
fields.name: client_id
fields.description: Unique ID of the Google Drive application that is used to create an authentication token required to access the API..

fields.title: Client Secret
fields.name: client_secret
fields.description: Unique Client Secret of the Google application that is used to create an authentication token required to access the API. For information on how to get the secret key, see Using OAuth 2.0 for Web Server Applications.

fields.title: Authorization Code
fields.name: code
fields.tooltip: The authorization code that you have acquired during the authorization step. For more information, see the Accessing the Google Drive API section.
fields.description: The authorization code that you acquired during the authorization step. For more information, see the Accessing the Google Drive API section.

fields.title: Redirect URL
fields.description: The redirect_uri of your app, where authentication responses can be sent and received by your app. It must exactly match one of the redirect_uri's you registered in the app registration portal.
fields.name: redirect_url
fields.tooltip: The redirect_uri of your app, where authentication responses can be sent and received by your app. It must exactly match one of the redirect_uri's you registered in the app registration portal.

fields.title: Verify SSL
fields.name: verify_ssl
fields.description: Specifies whether the SSL certificate for the server is to be verified or not. By default, this option is set as True.

operations.title: Get File List
operations.description: Gets a list of all the files in Google Drive based on the count of files you have specified.

parameters.title: Page Size
parameters.description: Specify the number of file to display per page
parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.tooltip: Specify the number of file to display per page

operations.title: Delete File
operations.description: Deletes a file from Google Drive based on the file ID you have specified.

parameters.title: File ID
parameters.tooltip: The ID of the file to delete
parameters.description: Specify the file ID of the file to delete from Google Drive. You can get the file ID from the Get File List operation. step.
parameters.name: fileId

operations.title: Empty Trash
operations.description: Permanently deletes all of the user's files from the Trash folder.

operations.title: Upload File
operations.description: Uploads a file to Google Drive based on the attachment IRI you have specified.

parameters.title: Attachment IRI
parameters.tooltip: Specify the attachment IRI of the file to upload. The attachment IRI can be found in the Dynamic Values -> IRI Lookup.
parameters.description: Specify the attachment IRI of the file to upload. The attachment IRI can be found in the Dynamic Values -> IRI Lookup.
parameters.name: fileIRI

parameters.title: New File Name
parameters.tooltip: Specify a name for the uploaded file. If left blank, it takes the filename associated with the specified attachment IRI.
parameters.description: Specify a name for the uploaded file. If left blank, it takes the filename associated with the specified attachment IRI.
parameters.name: new_file_name

operations.title: Remove File Share
operations.description: Removes sharing permissions from a file. You can target a specific permission ID, a specific email address, or remove all non-owner sharing permissions.

parameters.title: File ID
parameters.tooltip: ID of the file to unshare
parameters.description: Specify the file ID of the file to unshare.
parameters.name: file_id

parameters.title: Permission ID
parameters.description: Specify a permission ID to remove a specific share. If omitted, the connector can remove by email address or remove all non-owner permissions.
parameters.name: permission_id

parameters.title: Email Address
parameters.description: Specify the shared user's email address to remove their access. Ignored when Permission ID is provided.
parameters.name: email_address

operations.title: Download File
operations.description: Downloads a file from Google Drive based on the file ID you have specified. It then creates a record in FortiSOAR's Attachments module.

parameters.title: File ID
parameters.tooltip: ID of the file to Download
parameters.description: Specify the ID of the file to download from Google Drive. You can get the file ID from the Get File List operation. Note: The file ID that you have specified for download must not have .folder appended in the mimeType.
parameters.name: file_id
